---
title: Render-components override
format: q2-preview
render-components:
  - overrides.tsx
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      requires_js: true
    q2-preview:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # must-match — both overrides fire
        -
          - 'p.my-para'
          - 'div.my-callout'
        # must-not-match — built-in callout class must NOT appear
        # since the user's Callout override shadows it
        -
          - 'div.callout'
          - 'div.q2-preview-placeholder'
---

A regular paragraph that exercises the user `Para` override.

::: {.callout-note}
Body text — replaced wholesale by the user `Callout` override.
:::
